SRC-108:R001.text: Do not create another broad architecture umbrella.
SRC-108:R001.verification: One module, 359 lines, tools/saipen_engine/telemetry.py. No umbrella: it owns no state, writes no file, and is imported by no other engine module.

SRC-108:R002.text: Do not interrupt higher-priority active correctness / closure / field-gate work.
SRC-108:R002.verification: T-1595 was sequenced behind T-1471's already-DONE needs and ran after them; nothing higher-priority was interrupted.

SRC-108:R003.verification: It must never independently decide Work state, acceptance, PASS, DONE, Source ownership or mutation authority. NoAuthorityTests proves no saipen_engine module imports telemetry; every payload carries an explicit authority line.

SRC-108:R004.text: If the metrics cache disappears, SAIPEN must be able to reconstruct the useful statistics from canonical durable events where practical.
SRC-108:R004.verification: There is no metrics cache to lose. load() rebuilds from the canonical LOG on every call, so deletion of any cache is a no-op by construction.

SRC-108:R005.text: Do not create a second lifecycle database.
SRC-108:R005.verification: No second lifecycle database: no new store, table or file. The only read is the existing canonical LOG.

SRC-108:R006.text: Do not create one opaque "agent score".
SRC-108:R006.verification: No agent score exists. The projection is per-phase seconds plus explicit counts; nothing is aggregated into one rankable number.

SRC-108:R007.text: Do not create checkpoints solely to improve statistics.
SRC-108:R007.verification: No writes at all. test_stats_writes_nothing and test_the_verb_writes_nothing pin a byte-identical .saipen digest across a stats call.

SRC-108:R008.text: Do not invent dozens of micro-categories.
SRC-108:R008.verification: Nine classes, and they are the STATE phases already in the protocol (SCOUT/BUILD/VERIFY/REVIEW/SHIP) plus WAIT/BLOCKED/RECOVERY/UNKNOWN. No micro-categories were invented.

SRC-108:R009.text: Do not duplicate them into another independent taxonomy.
SRC-108:R009.verification: No second taxonomy: _op() and _TRANSITION_RE read the existing op and transition grammar, and the LOG's own taxonomy string is reused.

SRC-108:R010.verification: Undated events are dropped rather than guessed (test_an_undated_event_is_dropped_not_guessed); gaps over 30m and time after a stop are UNOBSERVED, never zero.

SRC-108:R011.text: Do not attempt to infer private model "thinking time" unless the host exposes a reliable measured value.
SRC-108:R011.verification: No thinking-time inference of any kind. Every number is a difference between two durable timestamps.

SRC-108:R012.verification: Do not count repeated reads, repeated unchanged commands, repeated identical tests or prose confidence. is_progress() accepts only machine-owned grammar -- a transition line matching _TRANSITION_RE, a finish, or an evidence marker. Repeated activity consumes TIME and never registers as PROGRESS.

SRC-108:R013.text: Do not expose misleading precision when data is unavailable.
SRC-108:R013.verification: precision is 'minute' on every payload, and every duration renders at minute resolution.

SRC-108:R014.verification: worker_generations, agent_incarnations and manual_recoveries are None, never 0 (test_unreconstructible_counters_are_unknown_not_zero).

SRC-108:R015.verification: Pace reports count, average, median AND longest; the day row also splits observed into active/waiting/blocked. No average stands alone.

SRC-108:R016.text: Do not require every historical ticket to have perfect telemetry before the feature can ship.
SRC-108:R016.verification: Events without a usable timestamp are dropped, so an incomplete historical ticket degrades that ticket's numbers instead of blocking the readout.

SRC-108:R017.text: Do not create many overlapping commands.
SRC-108:R017.verification: One verb: saipen stats. --work and --days narrow it; they do not add commands.

SRC-108:R018.text: Do not make the command mutating.
SRC-108:R018.verification: Read-only. Two tests pin that a stats call leaves the .saipen tree byte-identical.

SRC-108:R019.text: Do not make metrics collection depend on the operator calling `stats`.
SRC-108:R019.verification: Nothing is collected. Every number is derived on demand from the LOG, so no metric depends on the operator ever calling stats.

SRC-108:R020.text: Do not dump the full dashboard into:
SRC-108:R020.verification: Do not dump the dashboard into saipen status, saipen continue or AUTO_RECALL. None of the three was touched; stats is reachable only by naming it.

SRC-108:R021.text: AUTO_RECALL must remain bounded and execution-oriented.
SRC-108:R021.verification: AUTO_RECALL was not modified and does not reference telemetry; it remains bounded and execution-oriented.

SRC-108:R022.text: never make canonical lifecycle correctness depend on it
SRC-108:R022.verification: Canonical lifecycle correctness never depends on telemetry: the engine's decision paths cannot see it (NoAuthorityTests).

SRC-108:R023.text: A deleted metrics cache must not prevent:
SRC-108:R023.verification: A deleted metrics cache must not prevent protocol correctness. There is no cache and no required artifact; deleting the module leaves the protocol whole.

SRC-108:R024.verification: The system degrades to TELEMETRY_UNAVAILABLE with a detail string and exit 2 -- never an exception (test_an_unreadable_history_exits_two_not_raises).

SRC-108:R025.text: Do not introduce mixed naive/local timestamp semantics.
SRC-108:R025.verification: Every timestamp is parsed to an aware datetime before arithmetic; local time is introduced only for grouping, never for duration.

SRC-108:R026.text: Daily grouping may render in the configured/local timezone, but duration calculation must not break across:
SRC-108:R026.verification: Grouping is local-tz and duration crosses the boundary: _split_by_local_day splits an interval at local midnight and test_local_midnight_splits_an_interval pins 21:10-21:20 UTC onto the next Tallinn day.

SRC-108:R027.text: Duration must come from durable timestamps, not conversation order.
SRC-108:R027.verification: Durations are differences of durable LOG timestamps; conversation order is never consulted.

SRC-108:R028.text: Do not build a leaderboard now.
SRC-108:R028.verification: No leaderboard. Nothing in the projection ranks agents; 'agents' is a sorted set of names that touched the day.

SRC-108:R029.text: Do not count ordinary new user requests as "manual recovery".
SRC-108:R029.verification: manual_recoveries is None, and the derived recoveries counter counts only reconcile/log-repair/recover/migrate ops -- never an ordinary new user request.

SRC-108:R030.text: Do not attempt semantic defect mining from prose.
SRC-108:R030.verification: No semantic defect mining from prose. Progress is decided by op grammar and a transition regex, never by reading meaning out of a sentence.

SRC-108:R031.text: The metrics layer must be cheap.
SRC-108:R031.verification: Cheap: one LOG read per call, no cache to warm, no background work, no index.

SRC-108:R032.text: Ordinary mutation operations must not perform expensive historical scans merely to maintain statistics.
SRC-108:R032.verification: Ordinary mutations perform no historical scan: no engine module imports telemetry, so no mutation path can be paying to maintain statistics.

SRC-108:R033.text: Do not turn every checkpoint into a full LOG replay.
SRC-108:R033.verification: No checkpoint writes anything, so no checkpoint triggers a LOG replay. The read happens only when a human asks.

SRC-108:R034.text: Do not introduce semantics such as:
SRC-108:R034.verification: No invented leaderboard/score/health semantics were introduced; the projection is counts and durations only.

SRC-108:R035.text: Do not make these required for the first implementation.
SRC-108:R035.verification: None of the deferred extras (worker_generations, agent_incarnations, manual_recoveries) is required for this readout -- they are reported as None.

SRC-108:R036.verification: 359 lines of module, 15 named tests, one verb, no configuration, no dependency.

SRC-108:R038.verification: metrics are derived: load() rebuilds from the canonical LOG on every call; there is no cache and no collection step.

SRC-108:R039.text: metrics loss does not affect protocol correctness
SRC-108:R039.verification: metrics loss does not affect protocol correctness: deleting saipen_engine/telemetry.py changes no Work state, acceptance, PASS or DONE, because no engine module imports it.

SRC-108:R040.verification: durations survive model replacement: test_a_model_replacement_does_not_reset_work_elapsed asserts 85m across an a->b handoff, with only the phase boundary splitting it.

SRC-108:R041.text: durations survive supervisor restart where durable timestamps exist
SRC-108:R041.verification: durations survive supervisor restart: intervals are reconstructed from consecutive LOG timestamps, so a restart that writes a checkpoint yields an interval instead of a reset.

SRC-108:R042.verification: QUALITY > TIME semantics unchanged: no rule, no STATE field and no transition was modified; QUALITY-TIME-01 was already registered and is untouched.

SRC-108:R043.text: slow progress is not converted into failure
SRC-108:R043.verification: Slow progress is not converted into failure: nothing in the engine reads telemetry, so no duration can reach a verdict (NoAuthorityTests).

SRC-108:R044.text: Do not pause an active critical corridor to build a dashboard.
SRC-108:R044.verification: No active corridor was paused to build this. T-1595 ran as ordinary Work and the readout is on-demand.

SRC-108:R045.verification: WHAT MUST HAPPEN NEXT -- it can now answer HOW LONG DID IT TAKE and WHERE DID THE TIME GO from the canonical LOG alone: saipen stats gives current Work/phase elapsed, time since checkpoint and since progress, per-day observed/active/wait/blocked and pace; saipen stats --work T-#### gives that ticket's total, time-to-first-progress, per-phase seconds, checkpoint and recovery counts.

SRC-108:R046.verification: DO NOT WORSHIP IT. Telemetry has no goal, no auto-kick and no reference from STATE; deleting it degrades a readout to 'unavailable' and changes nothing else.
